question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word:

 PRUDENT
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4 - Wary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Prudent"** means acting with or showing care and thought for the future. (सावधान, विवेकपूर्ण)

 
 
• **Example:** It is prudent to save a portion of your income for emergencies.
 

 
• **"Wary"** refers to someone who is cautious or alert to possible dangers or problems. (सावधान)

 
 
• **Example:** She was wary of investing in a new business without proper research.
 

 
• Hence, the most appropriate synonym for **"Prudent"** is **"Wary."**

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4 - Wary**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Rash** (अविवेकी): Acting without careful thought or consideration, often leading to bad decisions.
 
 
• **Example:** It was a rash decision to quit the job without a backup plan.
 
 
 
• **Impulsive** (आवेगपूर्ण): Acting suddenly without careful thought, often driven by emotions.
 
 
• **Example:** He made an impulsive purchase at the store and later regretted it.
 
 
 
• **Careless** (लापरवाह): Not giving enough attention to details, often leading to errors or accidents.
 
 
• **Example:** His careless attitude caused the team to lose the project.
